description: This file defines the CollectPathsToExcludeEvent class, which is an event class used within the Drupal package_manager module to manage paths that should be excluded from certain operations, such as copying during staging. It includes methods for adding paths, retrieving all paths, adding paths relative to web and project roots, and scanning directories by name.

classes.name: CollectPathsToExcludeEvent
classes.description: An event class for collecting and managing paths to exclude during staging, implementing path list interface and providing methods for path management relative to web and project roots, as well as directory scanning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with a sandbox manager, path locator, path factory, and optional path list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more paths to the exclusion list.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all unique paths in the exclusion list.

methods.name: addPathsRelativeToWebRoot
methods.description: Flags paths to be ignored, relative to the web root, assuming they exist within the web root.

methods.name: addPathsRelativeToProjectRoot
methods.description: Flags paths to be ignored, relative to the project root, handling absolute and relative paths, with validation.

methods.name: scanForDirectoriesByName
methods.description: Finds all directories in the project root matching a given name.
